topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and sanctions (POL-01 4.8); annual acknowledgment of POL-05
evidence: EV-013 (code of conduct; sanctions log); EV-040 (acknowledgment report, 97%)

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Information Security Officer, Privacy Officer, vCISO, system owner, and MSP program owner designated; reporting lines in POL-01
Background checks before hire; annual training (96%); E-Verify Tutorial for all users
gap: No role-based training for payroll, billing, onboarding, or MSP staff (P07 AT-3)

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and POA&M; performance measures for the Security Manager and MSP program staff
SIEM with identity, endpoint, and cloud logs; BIA and data flows documented
gap: VMS, payroll, and ATS logs not in the SIEM; no data inventory (P07 AU-2, CM-8)
remediation: SaaS log connectors and data inventory (POAM-006, POAM-008)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; acknowledgment yearly; security reporting channel
gap: 4 of 15 interviewed staff did not know how to report an incident (P07 IR-6)

control_description: MSP client contracts state security commitments and 48-hour incident notice; system description in draft
gap: Commitments not yet written into a system description; supplier security expectations not communicated to the 65 MSP suppliers
remediation: System description; supplier security terms in the program rules

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives, risk appetite, and tolerance in P01 and POL-01
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering the MSP system (P01)
Fraud risks recorded: pay diversion, ghost associates, supplier invoice fraud, remittance redirection (R-001, R-009, R-020)
gap: Supplier invoice and bank change fraud controls in the VMS not designed (R-020)
remediation: Call-back on supplier bank changes; invoice anomaly review (STD-10)

control_description: Significant changes assessed through the risk process
gap: SaaS and AI changes made without assessment (P07 CM-3)

control_description: Annual co-sourced internal audit; monthly security metrics
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline and P01 risks (P02)
General IT controls for access, change, and operations
gap: Change and access review controls not operating for SaaS

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 and standards STD-01 to STD-10
gap: 7 of 10 standards still in draft

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA for staff; app-based MFA in the VMS; encryption at rest
evidence: EV-002 (IdP settings); EV-011 (VMS settings); EV-SC-28 (P07 SC-28)
gap: VMS outside SSO; exposed payroll API key until rotation; associate SMS sign-in (P07 IA-5, IA-2)
remediation: VMS on SSO; secrets service (POAM-004); associate authentication (POAM-003)

control_description: Account requests approved by managers; HR-driven provisioning in the IdP
gap: VMS accounts created by program staff without tickets
remediation: VMS requests through the IdP workflow

control_description: Role-based access in the ATS, payroll, VMS
gap: Quarterly reviews not performed; departed users active in the VMS; broad ATS roles (P07 AC-2, AC-3, AC-6)

control_description: Badge access at HQ and branches; provider data centers inherited
gap: Closet keys exposed at 3 branches (P07 PE-3)

control_description: Shredding with certificates; device wipes
gap: Kiosk and clock disposals without certificates (P07 MP-6)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls, cloud hub deny-by-default, no internet ingress to workloads
gap: Kiosks on staff networks at 9 branches (P07 SC-7)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for all transmissions; no Restricted data by email (POL-04)
gap: 212 emails with I-9 images and file-share SSN extracts found

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all laptops and kiosks with 24x7 MSSP; users cannot install software

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly scans; posture service in the cloud
gap: Containers unscanned; 9 of 41 critical findings late; SaaS configuration drift not detected (P07 RA-5, CM-3)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors endpoints, identity, and cloud 24x7
gap: No monitoring of VMS, payroll, or ATS activity (P07 AU-6, SI-4)

control_description: Security events triaged by the MSSP and the security analyst
gap: Pay diversion and VMS events not triaged as security events

control_description: Two runbooks with a notification matrix including the 48-hour MSP notice
gap: Runbooks untested

control_description: Recovery in BIA order; write-once backups
gap: No approved contingency plan; integration platform restore failed (P07 CP-2, CP-10)

control_description: Infrastructure changes approved in the ticket workflow
gap: SaaS, VMS, and integration code changes not under change control; no secure development requirements

control_description: BIA and two runbooks address business disruption; cyber insurance
gap: Manual payroll and contingency plan missing

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor SOC 2 reports collected; first structured reviews in Part B
gap: No tiering or contract terms for most vendors; credentialing vendor has no report (P07 SA-9, SR-6)

control_description: VMS capacity managed by the vendor (SOC 2); integration platform scales on the container service
Write-once backups in a second region; VMS vendor recovery RTO 24 hours, RPO 4 hours; inherited environmental protections
gap: Integration platform secrets outside backup scope

control_description: Recovery testing
gap: No recovery test for the MSP system (VMS export, integration platform, consolidated invoicing)
remediation: Quarterly restore tests and an MSP outage exercise (POAM-010)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Classification in POL-04; MSP client cost centers and supplier rates are Confidential
gap: Confidential MSP data not yet inventoried; VMS exports land in file shares

control_description: Retention and disposal schedule in POL-04 4.6
gap: No retention rule for MSP data after a client exits; no purge yet
remediation: Add MSP data to STD-04; first purge 2027-01-31

control_description: Processing objectives defined in MSP agreements: accurate supplier timesheets and one consolidated weekly invoice per client
gap: Processing specifications not documented in the system description

control_description: VMS validates required fields and approver for timesheets
gap: VMS time imports into payroll not checked for duplicates (R-027)
remediation: Duplicate checks in the integration platform

control_description: Integration platform applies rates and posts approved time to billing
gap: No weekly reconciliation of billed hours to approved hours
remediation: Weekly reconciliation report reviewed by the Controller

control_description: Consolidated invoices reviewed by program staff before release
gap: Review is a spot-check, not documented

control_description: VMS and payroll data stored by vendors with backups; warehouse copy
